part.text: The dataset has complete records through December 2025. I’m comparing annual death counts directly and also expressing cyclist deaths relative to motorist deaths, so the outputs show both the absolute and relative gaps.

input.command: python3 -c 'import duckdb, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt; from pathlib import Path; out=Path("out"); out.mkdir(exist_ok=True); con=duckdb.connect(); df=con.execute("select year(crash_date) as year, sum(coalesce(number_of_motorist_killed,0))::int as motorist_deaths, sum(coalesce(number_of_cyclist_killed,0))::int as cyclist_deaths from read_parquet(?) where year(crash_date) between 2013 and 2025 group by 1 order by 1", ["data/crashes.parquet"]).fetchdf(); df["motorist_minus_cyclist_deaths"]=df.motorist_deaths-df.cyclist_deaths; df["cyclist_deaths_per_100_motorist_deaths"]=df.cyclist_deaths/df.motorist_deaths*100; assert df.year.tolist()==list(range(2013,2026)); df[["year","motorist_deaths","cyclist_deaths","motorist_minus_cyclist_deaths"]].to_csv(out/"values_1.csv",index=False); df[["year","motorist_deaths","cyclist_deaths","cyclist_deaths_per_100_motorist_deaths"]].to_csv(out/"values_2.csv",index=False); plt.figure(figsize=(12,6.5)); x=range(len(df)); w=.38; plt.bar([i-w/2 for i in x],df.motorist_deaths,width=w,label="Motorist deaths",color="#3b6fb6"); plt.bar([i+w/2 for i in x],df.cyclist_deaths,width=w,label="Cyclist deaths",color="#e58a36"); plt.xticks(list(x),df.year); plt.ylabel("Deaths (annual total)"); plt.title("Motorist and cyclist deaths in NYC, 2013–2025"); plt.grid(axis="y",alpha=.25); plt.legend(frameon=False); plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(out/"option_1.png",dpi=180); plt.close(); plt.figure(figsize=(12,6.5)); plt.plot(df.year,df.cyclist_deaths_per_100_motorist_deaths,marker="o",linewidth=2.3,color="#713f8c"); plt.axhline(100,color="#777",linestyle="--",linewidth=1,label="Equal deaths (100 per 100)"); plt.xticks(df.year); plt.ylabel("Cyclist deaths per 100 motorist deaths"); plt.title("Cyclist deaths relative to motorist deaths in NYC, 2013–2025"); plt.grid(alpha=.25); plt.legend(frameon=False); plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(out/"option_2.png",dpi=180); plt.close(); print(df.to_string(index=False)); print("saved outputs:",sorted(p.name for p in out.iterdir()))'
